title: Forecast hospital census from forecasting hubs
text: Two tibbles standard hubverse shape, shipped package toy data vignette: admission_history: observed weekly admissions, pull hub’s target time series (hubData::connect_target_timeseries()). admission_forecast: next 4 weeks admission quantile forecasts, pull hub (hubData::connect_hub() |> collect_hub()). Overlaying two one axis shows hub publishes: history black, forecast fan blue.  censcast gives two ways turn census forecast, depending whether past census data.
code: plot_fan(admission_forecast, truth = admission_history) +   labs(y = "Weekly admissions")

title: Forecast hospital census from forecasting hubs
text: Hubs publish admissions truth, census truth, census series come records. package ships toy version, census_history, generated convolving admission_history known LOS, pairs row row admission series. fit_los() recovers LOS deconvolving paired admission census time series: plot(fit) shows recovered survival curve:  Drop fit fcast_census() get census forecast, overlay observed census check alignment:
code: fit <- fit_los(   data = inner_join(     admission_history |> select(target_end_date, admissions = observation),     census_history |> select(target_end_date, census = observation),     by = "target_end_date"   ),   family = "negbin",   max_stay = 8 ) fit #> <los_fit> family=negbin  mu=2, k=1.7  P(LOS>8) = 0.0134 plot(fit) census_fit <- fcast_census(admission_forecast, fit, admission_history) plot_fan(census_fit, truth = census_history) +   labs(y = "Weekly census")

title: Forecast hospital census from forecasting hubs
text: census data available, set LOS literature priors. Running several priors makes assumption visible. Short stays put weight recent admissions; long stays smooth across many weeks:  plot_fan() treats unrecognised column trajectory grouper, user added los column needs configuration.
code: los_priors <- list(   "short (mu=0.5w)" = spec_los("negbin", mu = 0.5, k = 1.7, max_stay = 8),   "medium (mu=2w)" = spec_los("negbin", mu = 2, k = 1.7, max_stay = 8),   "long (mu=4w)" = spec_los("negbin", mu = 4, k = 1.7, max_stay = 8) )  census_priors <- imap(los_priors, \(s, name) {   fcast_census(admission_forecast, s, admission_history) |>     mutate(los = name) }) |>   bind_rows()  # Replicate truth across facets so each panel gets the black line. truth_faceted <- imap(los_priors, \(s, name) {   mutate(census_history, los = name) }) |>   bind_rows()  plot_fan(census_priors, truth = truth_faceted) +   facet_wrap(~los, ncol = 1) +   labs(y = "Weekly census")

title: Forecast hospital census from forecasting hubs
text: score_census() returns weighted interval score (WIS) per quantile via scoringutils. Pair forecast truth compare mean WIS across LOS priors: “medium” prior matches LOS used generate census_history (negbin(mu = 2, k = 1.7)), wins. real workflow, lean fit_los() census data exists use spec_los() priors sensitivity check.
code: imap(los_priors, \(s, name) {   fcast_census(admission_forecast, s, admission_history) |>     score_census(census_truth = census_history) |>     mutate(los = name) }) |>   bind_rows() |>   summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), .by = los) |>   arrange(mean_wis) #>               los  mean_wis #> 1  medium (mu=2w)  29.69379 #> 2    long (mu=4w)  76.89364 #> 3 short (mu=0.5w) 181.69018

title: Fit a length of stay survival curve from observed admissions and census — fit_los
text: Recovers P(LOS > d) deconvolving observed admissions census time series. Use last season's admissions census time series want data driven LOS fcast_census(). data, use spec_los() literature priors instead.

title: Fit a length of stay survival curve from observed admissions and census — fit_los
code: fit_los(data, family = "negbin", max_stay = 50, skip = max_stay)

title: Fit a length of stay survival curve from observed admissions and census — fit_los
text: data Data frame one row per time step two numeric columns: admissions (observed admissions time step) census (observed census time step). family Character. LOS distribution family fit. One "negbin", "normal", "lognormal", "geometric" (set spec_los()). Default "negbin". max_stay Integer. Longest LOS modelled, time step units data. returned survival vector length max_stay + 1. Default 50. skip Integer. Number time steps start series ignore loss. census depends admissions observation window, see. Default max_stay.

title: Fit a length of stay survival curve from observed admissions and census — fit_los
text: numeric vector length max_stay + 1 giving P(LOS > d) d = 0..max_stay, class los_fit. Drops directly fcast_census(). Fitted parameters family attached attributes.

title: Fit a length of stay survival curve from observed admissions and census — fit_los
text: instead line list (one observed length stay per patient), need fit_los(). Build empirical survival vector directly pass fcast_census(): surv <- 1 - stats::ecdf(los_values)(0:max_stay).

title: Fit a length of stay survival curve from observed admissions and census — fit_los
code: set.seed(1) true_surv <- spec_los("negbin", mu = 3, k = 2, max_stay = 30) admissions <- rpois(120, 20) census <- stats::convolve(admissions, rev(true_surv), type = "open")[   seq_along(admissions) ] fit <- fit_los(   data.frame(admissions = admissions, census = census),   family = "negbin", max_stay = 30 ) attr(fit, "params") #>       mu        k  #> 2.999999 1.999998
